name: A Heroes Elixir
description: This elixir takes almost twelve hours to brew, painstakingly adding each berry one at a time in a specialized order. One mistake and you have a bad elixir. But the results are well worth it.
effect: The whole party heals 3 HP and recovers from one status ailment. Cannot be used with Bestow. Two Turn Cooldown.
recipes: 500 Poke, 3 Oran Berries, 3 Sitrus Berries, 3 Lum Berries
